messages.body:
You are working on GitHub issue #85: "[P2][task] Replace 13 emit* methods with generic publishEvent in BaseChannelPlugin"

## Issue Details
BaseChannelPlugin has 14 protected async emit* methods that are thin wrappers around the same pattern:
- emitMessageReceived, emitMessageSent, emitMessageFailed, emitMessageDelivered, emitMessageRead
- emitReactionReceived, emitReactionRemoved, emitButtonClick, emitPoll, emitPollVote
- emitInstanceConnected, emitInstanceDisconnected, emitQrCode, emitMediaReceived

All follow: async emitXxx(params) { await this.natsClient.publish(eventType, { ...params, channelType: this.id }); }

### Issues
1. Boilerplate: every new event type needs a new method
2. Dead code: 6 _subject assignments never read
3. Type duplication: EmitXxxParams interfaces duplicate EventPayloadMap from @omni/core

### Fix
Replace with single: publishEvent<K extends keyof EventPayloadMap>(type: K, payload: EventPayloadMap[K], instanceId: string)
Update all 4 channels to use this.publishEvent() instead of this.emitXxx()

### Acceptance Criteria
- Single publishEvent<T>() method in BaseChannelPlugin
- All 4 channels migrated
- Dead _subject variables removed
- EmitXxxParams types removed (use EventPayloadMap from core)
- make check green

## YOUR TASK
1. First run /council to analyze this issue — get architectural review and recommendations
2. Then run /wish to generate a structured wish plan file with scope, acceptance criteria, and execution groups
3. You are DONE when the wish file is written to disk
